display.purpose: Homepage hero only; italic green spans mark the emotional pivot.

title.purpose: Listing card vehicle names — the serif at data scale.

data.purpose: Every price and payment. Inter 700 with tabular-nums; never the serif.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow: hover/focus elevation and the hero card deck. Surfaces are flat at rest.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for all transitions and the hero settle entrance.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: hero preview cards settle onto the desk. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The action color at work: white on Ledger Green, quiet 10px rectangle.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0e6b4f; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; padding: 13px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0a523c; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e6b4f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent with a hairline border that darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1b2420; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.5px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #cfc9b8; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #1b2420; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e6b4f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Term Pill
components.description: Floats on listing photos; dark scrim normally, Urgency Red at ≤6 months remaining.

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 300px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3dfd2; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: #1b2420; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(27,36,32,0.05), 0 18px 30px -18px rgba(27,36,32,0.28); } .ds-card-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #41504a, #1b2420); } .ds-card-pill { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 12px; background: rgba(18,24,21,0.8); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 18px 18px; } .ds-card-price { font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-price small { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13.5px; color: #5d6b64; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17.5px; margin: 4px 0 2px; } .ds-card-sub { font-size: 14px; color: #5d6b64; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Editorial structure: serif claim beside prose between hairline rules. Replaces icon-card grids.
components.html:
Exit without penalties

Transferring a lease to an approved driver costs a lender fee of a few hundred dollars — and your obligation ends the day the papers are signed.
components.css: .ds-ledger { border-top: 1px solid #cfc9b8; max-width: 720px; } .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; gap: 12px 40px; padding: 26px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfc9b8; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-row h3 { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 23px; margin: 0; color: #1b2420; } .ds-ledger-row h3 em { font-style: italic; color: #0e6b4f; } .ds-ledger-row p { margin: 0; color: #41504a; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; }

narrative.overview: LeaseBusters shows every number a lease shopper needs before contact is ever made, and the design system treats that transparency as its aesthetic. The interface is a well-kept ledger: warm paper, dark green-black ink, hairline rules instead of boxes, and numerals that align in tabular columns. The system carries the heritage of Canada's original lease takeover marketplace (est. 1990) through a serif display voice, while every piece of data is set in a plainspoken sans. Green is the color of money and action; red is spent only on genuine urgency. Surfaces are flat at rest and lift only when the visitor reaches for them.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink warmth with hairline structure, not card clutter
The deal math is the hero: numbers large, tabular, and never hidden
Serif voice (Fraunces) for persuasion, sans (Inter) for facts
One accent doing real work; urgency color rationed
Flat at rest, elevation as a response to intent

rules.name: The Money-Is-Green Rule
rules.body: Green means money or action, nothing else — and red is spent only on urgency (≤6 months left, over-pace kilometres). A screen with red on it should feel like it's telling you to hurry, because it is.

rules.name: The Serif-Speaks-Sans-Counts Rule
rules.body: Fraunces persuades; Inter informs. Every numeral on the site is Inter with tabular figures so columns of the ledger actually align.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: If nothing is happening, nothing floats. A surface earns shadow by being reached for, not by existing.

dos: Do set every numeral in Inter with tabular figures — prices, terms, odometers, fees.
Do separate content with hairlines on the paper before reaching for a box; a card must earn its border.
Do show the complete deal math on any surface that represents a listing.
Do draw icons as consistent 2px-stroke SVGs at 13–24px; theme selection, caret, and focus rings from the palette.
Do keep the one authored motion moment: the hero deck settling in, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use red for anything except genuine time pressure or over-pace warnings.
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker label above a heading, or open a section with a big-number stat trio.
Don't build page structure from same-size icon+heading+text cards; use ledger rows.
Don't set data in Fraunces or headlines in Inter.
Don't add ambient shadows to resting surfaces, gradient text, or glyph/emoji icons in the UI.
